mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE name LIKE #{keyword} AND status = 1
SELECT p.* FROM product p INNER JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name LIKE #{keyword} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product(name, description, price, stock, category_id, image, sales, status, create_time) VALUES(#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{categoryId}, #{image}, #{sales}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock - #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE product SET sales = sales + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET sales = sales - #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND sales >= #{quantity}
